stories.headline: Microsoft exits Nscale data-center deal
stories.summary: Britain's Telegraph says Microsoft ended an agreement for Nscale's Essex AI data center. Neither company commented and no reason was reported. The withdrawal could matter to Nscale, which recently filed for a US IPO.

stories.headline: China proposes controls on 23 AI technologies
stories.summary: Beijing proposed export controls covering AI models, agents and computing clusters. APIs, apps and cloud services would remain exempt. The rules are proposals under consultation through November 15, not final restrictions.

stories.headline: US measles count reaches 4,410
stories.summary: The CDC reported 4,410 cases through October 15, up 330 in one week, with 451 hospitalizations. Pennsylvania reports five related deaths, while the CDC has confirmed two nationally under its current mortality method.

stories.headline: Iran keeps Hormuz reopening offer on table
stories.summary: Iran says it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within six days if Washington accepts conditions including easing port and oil sanctions and ending regional hostilities. Talks remain stalled, especially over Iran's nuclear program.

stories.headline: Egypt offers support to defend Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Egypt says it is prepared to support Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks intensify. President Sisi requested parliamentary authorization for military assistance if Riyadh asks; approval and any deployment had not yet occurred.
